    Yaxel Lendeborg’s parents are Yissel Raposo and Okary Lendeborg, both former basketball players from the Dominican Republic who influenced his athletic career. His mother, Yissel, is credited with turning his life around through strict academic and athletic intervention and is currently battling appendix cancer. 
    Key Details About Yaxel Lendeborg's Parents: 
    • Mother (Yissel Raposo): A former volleyball player for the Dominican Republic national team and the American University of Puerto Rico. She staged an intervention during Yaxel's high school years to focus him on basketball, including managing his daily commute to Camden Community College. She is fighting appendix cancer as of 2026.
    • Father (Okary Lendeborg): Played for the Dominican Republic national basketball team. He noted that while he worked, Yaxel spent much of his time with his mother, who became a major role model.
    • Family Background: The family is of Dominican descent, with roots in Puerto Rico before moving to Ohio and later Pennsauken Township, New Jersey.
    • Support System: Yissel is known for being a dedicated supporter, frequently attending Yaxel's games even while undergoing chemotherapy.

    AI Overview
    Yaxel Lendeborg is a 6'9" forward for the Michigan Wolverines who was born in Puerto Rico on September 30, 2002. Of Dominican descent, he moved to Ohio at age two before settling in Pennsauken, New Jersey, at age eight, which he considers his hometown. He played high school basketball at Pennsauken High School. 
    Key Details About His Background: 
    • Birthplace: Puerto Rico.
    • Parents: His parents, Okary Lendeborg and Yissel Raposo, were both basketball players for the Dominican Republic national team.
    • Upbringing:
      He moved from Puerto Rico to Ohio as a toddler, and later to Pennsauken, NJ.
    • High School: He attended Pennsauken High School in New Jersey.
    • Career Path: After a limited high school career, he went to Arizona Western College, then to UAB, before transferring to Michigan. 
    Lendeborg has often cited his mother as a major influence, having worked together in a warehouse after high school before his basketball career took off.
